sentences.title: 易混淆词
lines: skin n. 人体的皮肤 leather n. 皮革 complexion n. 某人是什么颜色的皮肤（可与 skin 互换）
We are wet to the skin. He has a dark skin/complexion. Shoes made of real leather have become very expensive. This sofa is made from real leather. Look at her rosy cheeks.She has a lovely complexion.
B.C. = Before Christ 公元前（位于年代之 后 ） he Romans invaded England in 55 B.C. “B.C.” 不可省略，否则时间是错误的
in the yeare of the Lord = since Christ was born 公元（位于年代之 前 ） In the year of the Lord 2024 强调2024, many technological advancements have reshaped our society.
A.D. = anno Domini George I died in A.D. 1727. 强调是公元非公元前
wax n. 蜡（ 不可数 名词） candle n. 蜡烛（ 可数 名词）
All the figures in this shop are made of wax. I keep a candle by my bed in case the lights go out suddenly.

expand.title: 区别：ago / since / for
lines: ago 以前，从前 since 自…以后，自…以来 for 在…时，持续了...
通常搭配一般过去时 since + 过去的时间 = 现在完成时 无时态要求(可搭配任意)
They won the match three days ago. Since 1992, we have lived in this city. They have been practicing for a year.
He stayed with us for two weeks.
I have not seen him since Monday.
He left a month ago and I have not seen him since then.
W e have been working on this new plane for over a year now.
